question: Does daily air temperature range predict held-out 2023 within-day water-temperature amplitude and night/day slopes after controlling for air mean, month, and discharge?

data_scope.water_temperature: Original USGS instantaneous-value RDB files for sites 10396000, 11501000, 11502500; fit data from May-September 2014-2022 only; sole held-out year May-September 2023.
data_scope.excluded_year: 2024 is excluded from fitting, tuning, and primary evaluation.
data_scope.daily_predictors: Join existing pilot paired_daily_panel.csv exactly by site and local calendar date. No interpolation or alternate weather/flow source. Require finite air_mean, air_range and positive flow; derive log(flow).

water_day_filter.qualifier: Retain only water-temperature rows with qualifier exactly A.
water_day_filter.local_grid: Parse the RDB local wall-clock datetime and retain timestamps exactly on a 15-minute grid (minute in 00,15,30,45 and second zero when present). Local date is the timestamp date; no UTC conversion.
water_day_filter.daily_coverage: At least 87 distinct valid observations among the expected 96 local 15-minute slots. Duplicate timestamps count once; if repeated, retain the first A-qualified record in file order.

targets.A24: OLS first harmonic on retained within-day points: intercept + sin(2*pi*hour/24) + cos(2*pi*hour/24); target sqrt(sin_coefficient^2 + cos_coefficient^2).
targets.phi: Harmonic peak phase (atan2(sin coefficient, cos coefficient), mapped to [0,24)); descriptive only in first analysis.
targets.observed_extrema: Clock time of observed daily maximum and minimum, descriptive only.
targets.S_night: OLS temperature versus actual local elapsed hours for 18:00 on date D through 06:00 on D+1; order by true timestamp. Require at least 40 observations in the interval.
targets.S_day: OLS temperature versus actual local hours from 06:00 through 18:00 on date D. Require at least 40 observations in the interval.

primary_models.fit_unit: Separate OLS per USGS site and target, using all eligible dates in May-September 2014-2022. No hyperparameter tuning.
primary_models.baseline: Intercept + month categorical indicators + air_mean + ln(daily flow).
primary_models.comparison: Use identical complete-case site-date rows for both models; report held-out 2023 MAE and paired per-date absolute-error improvement (baseline absolute error minus expanded absolute error).
primary_models.training_direction: Report the fitted air_range coefficient from expanded model for each site-target; coefficient sign is descriptive conditional association, not mechanism. Also report pooled within-site coefficient summary only if clearly labeled descriptive.
primary_models.uncertainty: For 2023 paired MAE improvement, moving-block bootstrap within each station's chronological test rows using 28-day blocks, 2000 replicates, RNG seed 20261103; circular block starts; report percentile 95% interval.

stations: 11502500 Williamson River below Sprague River near Chiloquin
secondary_river_network_test.network_verification: Attempt public USGS NLDI/NHD network navigation from downstream station and check whether upstream mainstem navigation includes 11501000; save URL, retrieval date, status, and returned feature identifiers. If connectivity is not verified, remove flow-share/tributary-transfer interpretation and do not fit that explanatory model.
secondary_river_network_test.if_connected: Only after checking network response, compare models for held-out 2023 A24_down/A24_up and signed circular phase difference phi_down-phi_up. Use same-day Q_Sprague/Q_Williamson as predictor; control month, shared OCHI air_mean and air_range. Any lag/parameter choice is selected only within 2014-2022. State explicitly that ratio need not equal tributary fraction because of intervening inflows, withdrawals, storage, and measurement timing.
secondary_river_network_test.status: Secondary; no 2024 result is confirmatory evidence.

interpretive_limits: 2023 daily-scale data and related daily temperature analyses have already been accessed in this project; this is a new high-frequency target analysis but not an untouched-year discovery context.
Prediction improvement does not identify heat-exchange causality.
Daily air range/mean are weather-station summaries, not subdaily heat flux; site-specific stations may share meteorological source and measurement error.
Do not claim novelty or promote 2024 exploratory clues to confirmation.
